description: The chart illustrates the accuracy percentages of two datasets, PHEME and PolitiFact, across different categories. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled as "Ours", "w/o comments", "w/o text", "w/o select", "w/o emotion", and "w/o cognition", in a fixed order. The vertical axis represents the accuracy percentage, labeled as "Accuracy (%)", with a linear scale ranging from 75.0 to 95.0, and tick labels at intervals of 2.5. For both datasets, the bars are grouped by category, with each group containing a single bar colored according to the category: red for "Ours", orange for "w/o comments", yellow for "w/o text", light blue for "w/o select", blue for "w/o emotion", and dark blue for "w/o cognition". The bars are not stacked or sorted. For PHEME, the accuracy percentages are approximately 89.84 for "Ours", 86.82 for "w/o comments", 80.10 for "w/o text", 88.80 for "w/o select", 87.34 for "w/o emotion", and 87.17 for "w/o cognition". For PolitiFact, the accuracy percentages are approximately 90.57 for "Ours", 85.85 for "w/o comments", 83.02 for "w/o text", 89.62 for "w/o select", 84.91 for "w/o emotion", and 87.74 for "w/o cognition". No bars are visually emphasized.
